text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My days of training with Yaeno Muteki are well underway. One day, we run into one of her classmates on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is a diligent runner gaining popularity for her recent victories. It seems her role model, Maruzensky, has also taken her under her wing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We next come across Mejiro Ardan at the gym. The amount of training she can do is limited due to her poor constitution, but she does all she can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sight of her classmates working so hard lights a fire in Yaeno Muteki, who's determined to not be outdone by either of them.
